profile.headline: Software Engineer at GitHub
profile.summary: An experienced developer, start-up founder, and international speaker, Abraham brings a broad range of skills to his current role as a senior developer at Bendyworks. A top 1% contributor at Stack Overflow and an active member of Google Developer Groups, Abraham has been recognized by Google as a Developer Expert for his ability to identify technology problems and provide quality solutions in the community.

positions.title: Mason Tender
positions.description: Performed tasks such as tending to brick/block layers, & masons. The Mixing, handling, and conveying of all materials used by masons. The erecting, and dismantling of scaffolds, operating and maintenance of mixers, mortar pumps, etc.

positions.title: Dinner Chef
positions.description: Responsible for the ordering, preparation, and presentation of fine cuisine. General organization of the dinner staff and menus.

educations.schoolName: Maine School of Science and Mathematics
